citations.title: HAAS Alert: Volition Capital Closes Growth Investment
excerpts: # HAAS Alert: Volition Capital Closes Growth Investment
By * [Volition Press](https://www.volitioncapital.com/news-insights/all-articles/filter/all-formats/all-themes/all-topics/indicatemedia)
1/8/24 4 MIN READ
By [Volition Press](https://www.volitioncapital.com/news-insights/all-articles/filter/all-formats/all-themes/all-topics/indicatemedia) \- 1/8/24
Volution Capital
_Company will accelerate growth of Safety Cloud® platform connecting consumer vehicles to digital alerts from emergency vehicles, towing and recovery fleets, and roadway infrastructure equipment_

BOSTON , Jan. 8, 2024 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ — [Volition Capital](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=3603547025&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.volitioncapital.com%2F&a=Volition+Capital) , a leading technology and consumer growth equity firm, today announced it closed a growth investment in [HAAS Alert](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=2527614544&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.haasalert.com%2F&a=HAAS+Alert) , a company with the largest commercially-deployed connected vehicle network powered by its Safety Cloud® digital alerting platform. This investment follows rapid growth for HAAS Alert, with thousands of public safety and transportation agencies, roadway fleets, and municipalities using Safety Cloud to deliver road safety information and hazard warnings to drivers via in-app and in-vehicle alerts.

[According to an analysis by Deloitte](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=1268462000&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.deloitte.com%2Fus%2Fen%2Fpages%2Fadvisory%2Farticles%2Fconnected-vehicles-shift-an-industry.html&a=According+to+an+analysis+by+Deloitte) , there will be an estimated 470 million connected vehicles on highways worldwide by 2025, creating a significant opportunity for automobile OEMs to leverage network connectivity and the Internet of Things (IoT) not only for driver convenience and in-vehicle entertainment but to increase road safety. With emerging government regulations and technological advancements, features such as forward collision warning systems have become integral to automobile safety systems.

Despite the growth in connected cars and vehicle-specific safety features, the transportation system remains significantly disjointed. Millions of vehicles, from fire trucks and ambulances to tow trucks, snowplows, and school buses, rely on analog equipment like flashing lights, sirens, cones, and roadside signs to capture driver attention and communicate information about road hazards. With the rise in distracted driving, these tools become increasingly ineffective on their own, resulting in hundreds of thousands of preventable collisions and thousands of fatalities annually.

HAAS Alert’s digital alerting solution and connected vehicle platform improve road safety by bridging information gaps and data silos across the transportation industry. It creates a shared network for communicating critical safety information. Public safety fleets and towing vehicles connected to Safety Cloud can deliver digital alerts to drivers through in-vehicle screens and navigation applications as they approach active road hazards up to 30 seconds in advance, reducing the likelihood of collisions by up to 90%. Additionally, fleets using Safety Cloud can track their vehicle assets and easily share information with other nearby responding agencies for coordinated response and awareness on the road.

“Our vision is a connected, collision-free world where everyone gets home safely,” said [Cory Hohs](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=3910403682&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fcoryjameshohs%2F&a=Cory+Hohs) , CEO of HAAS Alert. “Tragically, more than 40,000 lives are lost on American roads every year in collisions that are largely preventable. We believe that connectivity can play a critical role in addressing this crisis and permanently make transportation safer for everyone. This investment will enable us to bring Safety Cloud protection to more vehicles, platforms, and communities of every size, and develop new digital alerting and connected safety solutions that ultimately save more lives.”

Safety Cloud® alerts already reach millions of drivers nationwide, including more than 2 million Stellantis vehicles (2018 and newer Jeep, Dodge, Ram, and Chrysler vehicles), as well as millions of drivers through navigation apps. The investment from Volition Capital will support HAAS Alert’s goal to expand Safety Cloud’s presence in consumer automotive vehicles and its user base, which includes more than 3,200 public safety and transportation agencies, roadway fleets, and municipalities. The capital will support the development of new platform integrations, partnerships, and innovative lifesaving use cases for its digital alerting technology.

“The market category for connected vehicle technology is ripe for innovation and has significant growth potential,” said [Roger Hurwitz](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=2005193889&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Froger-hurwitz-89458114%2F&a=Roger+Hurwitz) , Volition Capital Managing Partner. “Some of the most successful software solutions are ones that both address an industry need and work seamlessly with an existing technology stack. HAAS Alert’s growth has been fueled by widespread adoption of its solution by public safety agencies nationwide and Safety Cloud’s seamless integration with a variety of platforms that first responders, infrastructure operators, and transportation planners already use for protection on the road.”

HAAS Alert was founded in 2015. After co-founder Cory Hohs was nearly struck by a responding ambulance, he decided to leverage his background in mapping and navigation to explore how technology could enable real-time communication between things on the road. Along with [Jigar Patel](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=1129754050&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fjigar-patel-2471a95%2F&a=Jigar+Patel) , an engineer with a background in cloud computing and distributed systems, and [Noah Levens](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=383339828&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fnoah-levens-19b771a1%2F&a=Noah+Levens) , a creative product and brand designer, the three co-founded HAAS Alert and began work on what would become Safety Cloud.
About Volition Capital

Volition Capital is a Boston \-based growth equity firm that principally invests in high-growth, founder-owned companies across the software, Internet, and consumer sectors. Founded in 2010, Volition has over $1.7 billion in assets under management and has invested in and/or provided sub-advisory advice to more than 40 companies in the United States and Canada . The firm selectively partners with founders to help them achieve their fullest aspirations for their businesses. For more information, visit [http://www.volitioncapital.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=787836784&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.volitioncapital.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.volitioncapital.com) or follow us on Twitter [@volitioncapital](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=2438907175&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fvolitioncapital%3Flang%3Den&a=%40volitioncapital) .
About HAAS Alert

HAAS Alert’s mission is to build lifesaving mobility solutions to make vehicles and roads safer and smarter. Our vision is a connected, collision-free world where everyone gets home safely. HAAS Alert makes roads and communities safer by delivering digital alerts from emergency response, municipal and private fleets, work zones, and connected infrastructure to nearby drivers through its vehicle communication platform. For more information, visit [http://www.haasalert.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4062054-1&h=3765697943&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.haasalert.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.haasalert.com) .
**Media Contact**

What compliance certifications does your organization hold?

What is your data retention policy?

Our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) oversees the information security program, supported by a dedicated security team responsible for implementing and maintaining security controls.

excerpts: # WJ Group Leads the Way in Road Worker Safety with Safety Cloud

WJ Group, the UK’s largest road marking and highway maintenance provider, constantly looks for new ways to protect its crews and the public. Working just feet from fast-moving traffic creates risks that traditional cones and barriers cannot fully address.

To close those gaps, WJ Group became the first in the UK to adopt Safety Cloud digital alerting. This connected safety technology delivers real-time warnings to drivers, helping reduce the chance of dangerous incursions into work zones.
The full case study reveals how WJ Group:
* Integrated Safety Cloud into its nationwide fleet
* Strengthened protection for crews on short-duration, high-risk projects
* Enhanced communication with the public and supported local authority safety goals

On top of everything that his job requires of him, the Sheriff must also keep every employee that operates one of those vehicles safe. He decided to turn to [Safety Cloud by HAAS Alert](https://www.haasalert.com/safety-cloud) to make that happen.

excerpts: ## RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer
**About HAAS Alert**

HAAS Alert operates Safety Cloud®, the largest connected transportation + road safety platform in the world. We send real-time digital alerts to drivers and vehicles through their integrated screens and phones as they approach active first responder vehicles, emergency scenes, work zones, and other hazards on the road. Working with emergency responders, fleets, road operators, and automakers, our vision is singular and urgent: a connected, collision-free world where everyone gets home safely.
**Why HAAS Alert**

You'll join a mission-driven company whose product measurably protects first responders and roadway workers the work matters. You'll inherit a working stack and clear documentation, then get the freedom to build on top of it: new tooling, AI-driven enrichment, and GTM automation that our team has never had the bandwidth to prioritize. On a team this size, your impact is visible and fast and there's a lot of green field waiting for someone who wants to run with it.
**The Role**

This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's. You'll own the GTM engine for a lean, high-velocity go-to-market team and your job is to make the revenue org measurably faster and smarter, not just keep the lights on. Yes, you'll administer and optimize the existing stack (HubSpot, RevOps.io, Gong, RevHero, and more) and own the architecture and integrations behind it. But the real value is in what you build on top: AI-driven prospecting and enrichment, automated workflows, and tooling that gives sellers superpowers they don't have today.

You'll partner directly with SDRs, AEs, marketing, and leadership, there's no layer of bureaucracy between you and impact. This is a startup environment: you'll wear multiple hats, prioritize ruthlessly, and ship. If you want a narrow, keep-it-running RevOps role, this isn't it. If you want to engineer the GTM motion and see your work move the number, keep reading. You’ll be starting with a RevOps GTM platform and AI tools already in place and built, so not only will you be able to continue to build, but you’ll be joining with a platform and framework in place ready for your ingenuity and curiosity to get to work.
**What You'll Do**
**Run the stack (the foundation)**

• **Own HubSpot:** administer and continuously improve our HubSpot instance: workflows, sequences, lifecycle stages, properties, lead routing, deal stages, reporting, and data hygiene. You know HubSpot backwards and forwards.

• **Own systems architecture & integrations:** keep integrations across HubSpot, RevOps.io, Gong, and RevHero done right…data flowing cleanly, no silent breakages, and a stack that holds up as we scale.

• **Own the data layer:** make changes in our internal tool and comfortable enough to work with the engineering team for Snowflake integrations to keep reporting accurate and the source of truth trustworthy. You don't need to be a data engineer on day one, you'll ramp with documentation left behind, Claude Code, and support from our data team.
• **Report & forecast:** build the funnel, pipeline, forecast, and activity reporting leadership relies on, and partner with sales leadership on pipeline reviews and forecast accuracy.
**Build the engine (the impact)**
• **Give sellers superpowers:** stand up modern GTM tooling like Clay to power automated prospecting, list building, and data enrichment that reps don't have today.
• **Engineer with AI:** use AI tools and AI enrichment to eliminate manual work and build automations, workflows, and signals that make the whole GTM motion faster and smarter.
• **Ship new plays:** spot bottlenecks and opportunities across the revenue process and build the solution proactively, not just when asked. This is where the role earns its keep.

citations.title: HAAS Alert Secures $50,000 Scale Grant to Expand Detroit Footprint  | HAAS Alert
excerpts: ## HAAS Alert Secures $50,000 Scale Grant to Expand Detroit Footprint
April 17, 2026
Written by
the HAAS Alert Team
Nicholas Little
SHARE
Reading Progress:

_Chicago, IL — April 17, 2026_ — When HAAS Alert opened its Detroit office at Newlab at Michigan Central in May 2024, the objective was to embed life-saving vehicle technology into the fabric of the Motor City. That commitment has now advanced through receipt of a $50,000 Scale Grant from the Detroit Startup Fund, an initiative led by Mary Sheffield and the Detroit Economic Growth Corporation.

The fund is designed to move companies beyond early traction into sustained growth. While Seed Grants support early-stage ideas, the Scale Grant is reserved for companies that have proven market demand, have attracted outside capital, and can convert that momentum into jobs and measurable industry impact. HAAS Alert was one of three companies selected for the $50,000 award, reinforcing its position within Detroit’s connected safety and automotive ecosystem. Most importantly, it allows HAAS Alert to expand its work with local partners to keep first responders safe.
## **Protecting Detroit’s Finest**

HAAS Alert considers Detroit a second home, and this funding is a major step toward broadening its footprint across a region where public infrastructure, OEMs, and vehicle technology are increasingly interdependent. Most importantly, it allows HAAS Alert to expand its work with local partners to keep first responders safe.

Following a landmark citywide rollout completed in August 2025, HAAS Alert’s digital alerting technology is active across the Detroit Fire Department and the Detroit Police Department. Since launch, hundreds of thousands of digital alerts have been delivered directly to motorists’ dashboards and navigation systems, reducing collision risk for first responders operating in traffic.

HAAS Alert is proud to be a recipient of this grant and recognizes the leadership of Mary Sheffield and the support of the Detroit Economic Growth Corporation in advancing this work. The mission remains to ensure every first responder in Detroit and beyond returns home safely at the end of each day.
CLICK TO DOWNLOAD NOW

excerpts: ## HAAS Alert Launches Safety Cloud® For Android Automotive, Giving Automakers a Ready-to-Deploy Connected Safety Experience
SHARE
_Customizable Android Automotive OS application delivers real-time V2X road hazard alerts over the vehicle’s existing cellular connectivity._

**CHICAGO, IL -** HAAS Alert today announced Safety Cloud® for Android Automotive, an embedded application that connects AAOS-equipped vehicles directly to its Safety Cloud network. The launch gives automakers a production-ready connected safety experience they can deliver to customers over existing cellular connectivity, without dedicated V2X hardware.

Built to install through an OEM’s existing Android Automotive software architecture, Safety Cloud distributes via standard over-the-air updates or factory installation. Once activated, it launches automatically when the vehicle starts and runs in the background while driving.
